:= by
  have h1 : Finite (Mˣ) := Finite.units (Finite M)
  have h2 : AbelianGroup (Mˣ) := AbelianGroup.ofCommMonoid M
  have h3 : HasEnoughRootsOfUnity R (Monoid.exponent Mˣ) := 
    HasEnoughRootsOfUnity.of_le (Monoid.exponent Mˣ) (Monoid.exponent Mˣ) rfl
  have h4 : Nat.card (MulChar M R) = Nat.card (Mˣ) :=
    MulChar.card_eq_group_card M R h1 h2 h3
  exact h4
